browser.open: open({actor,am,agentId}) => {page,origin,switchAM(nextAm),close()} actual isolated Playwright session under parent browser lease
browser.evidence: evidence(page) => sanitized actual HTTP request IDs/ingress/timings; Agent-bound requests retain current owner/epoch and distinct nonowner proof; compiled web source identity
browser.capture: Author modules attach actual Page response/download/filechooser listeners. No optional browser.responses API needed.

user-fixtures.take: take(name,ctx) => setup fields listed below plus local=true,run_owned=true,webSource=<40hex>,cleanup()
user-fixtures.cleanup: Exact created resources only, public cleanup; return {complete:true,owned_only:true}; no user verdict oracle or checklist steps in fixture.
user-fixtures.lifetime: Retain dedicated Agent witness across parent restart where required; no second application or private repair.

usage.data: At least51 owned usage rows and >1 page lifecycle events for selected sandbox; missing measured samples and complete/partial allocation intervals. Same exact candidate image on both AMs. No admin scope on user.
usage.source_evidence: Actual /metrics/view freshness/generated_at/refresh fields and report_id; no invented cache-state metadata.

agent-history.data: Real completed and interrupted provider turns; parent low-level provider controls to release a new event during reload; turn/entry identities retained.

agent-files.data: Owned bounded text+image fixtures, 1MiB+1 oversized content, actual Agent change/deliverable events; provider/fault controls for source change/removal and upload failure.

agent-controls.data: Dedicated running Agent with confirmed durable lifecycle oracle; actual harmless catalog skill/version; Stop/Delete cleanup never accepts404 alone.

desktop.data: Actual supported runtime display/browser renderer and harmless provider action; frame/pixel and nativeinput observation; parent holds runtime and browser fixture lease.

trigger-publisher.data: Disposable publisher and independent visitor identities, valid local model/image/skills/service choices; actual public launch and cleanup, low-level bounded observation-loss/terminal-failure fixture.

navigation.data: Real CMA and EG compiled surfaces behind same governed browser; local non-admin account without operations capability.
